text_en: “But now they make sport of me, those who are younger than I, whose fathers I would have disdained to set with the dogs of my flock.
text_cn: 但现今年纪小于我的人，都嘲笑我；这些人的父亲，我都不屑于列在守我羊群的狗中。

text_en: What could I gain from the strength of their hands? All their vigor is gone.
text_cn: 他们的精力已经丧失，他们手臂的力量，对我还有何用？

text_en: Through want and hard hunger they gnaw the dry and desolate ground,
text_cn: 他们因贫乏和饥馑而消瘦，咀嚼旷野里的草根，以及荒山野岭所生的荆棘。

text_en: they pick mallow and the leaves of bushes, and to warm themselves the roots of broom.
text_cn: 他们由丛莽中采取咸菜，以杜松根做自己的食物。

text_en: They are driven out from society; people shout after them as after a thief.
text_cn: 人将他们由人群中逐出，在他们后面喊叫有如追贼；

text_en: In the gullies of wadis they must live, in holes in the ground, and in the rocks.
text_cn: 他们只得避居于深谷，住在山洞和岩穴中；

text_en: Among the bushes they bray; under the nettles they huddle together.
text_cn: 在荆棘丛中哀叹，在葛藤下萎缩。

text_en: A senseless, disreputable brood, they have been whipped out of the land.
text_cn: 这些人都是流氓的后代，都是无名氏之子孙，由本国驱逐境外的。

text_en: “And now they mock me in song; I am a byword to them.
text_cn: 但现今我竟成了他们的歌谣，做了他们的话柄。

text_en: They abhor me, they keep aloof from me; they do not hesitate to spit at the sight of me.
text_cn: 他们因憎恶我而远离我，竟任意向我脸上吐唾沫。

text_en: Because God has loosed my bowstring and humbled me, they have cast off restraint in my presence.
text_cn: 他们解开了缰绳以攻击我，在我面前除掉了辔（pèi）头。

text_en: On my right hand the rabble rise up; they send me sprawling, and build roads for my ruin.
text_cn: 下流之辈在我右边起来，向我投掷石头，筑成一条使我丧亡的路。

text_en: They break up my path, they promote my calamity; no one restrains them.
text_cn: 他们破坏了我的道路，使我跌仆，却没有人阻止他们。

text_en: As through a wide breach they come; amid the crash they roll on.
text_cn: 他们由宽大的缺口进入，辗(zhǎn)转于废墟之中。

text_en: Terrors are turned upon me; my honor is pursued as by the wind, and my prosperity has passed away like a cloud.
text_cn: 恐怖临于我身，我的尊荣如被风吹散，我的救恩如浮云逝去。

text_en: “And now my soul is poured out within me; days of affliction have taken hold of me.
text_cn: 现今我的心神已颓废，忧患的日子不放松我。

text_en: The night racks my bones, and the pain that gnaws me takes no rest.
text_cn: 夜间痛苦刺透我骨，我的脉络都不得安息。

text_en: With violence he seizes my garment; he grasps me by the collar of my tunic.
text_cn: 天主以大力抓住我的衣服，握紧我长衣的领口，

text_en: He has cast me into the mire, and I have become like dust and ashes.
text_cn: 将我投入泥中，使我变成灰土。

text_en: I cry to you and you do not answer me; I stand, and you merely look at me.
text_cn: 天主啊！我向你呼号，你不回答我；我立起来，你也不理睬我。

text_en: You have turned cruel to me; with the might of your hand you persecute me.
text_cn: 你对我变成了暴君，用你有力的手迫害我。

text_en: You lift me up on the wind, you make me ride on it, and you toss me about in the roar of the storm.
text_cn: 你将我提起，乘风而去，使我在狂风中飘摇不定。

text_en: I know that you will bring me to death, and to the house appointed for all living.
text_cn: 我知道你要导我于死亡，到众生聚集的家乡。

text_en: “Surely one does not turn against the needy, when in disaster they cry for help.
text_cn: 若穷人遇到不幸向我求救，我岂不伸手去援助他？

text_en: Did I not weep for those whose day was hard? Was not my soul grieved for the poor?
text_cn: 人遭难，我岂没有流泪？人穷乏，我的心岂没有怜悯？

text_en: But when I looked for good, evil came; and when I waited for light, darkness came.
text_cn: 我希望幸福，来的却是灾祸；我期待光明，黑暗反而来临。

text_en: My inward parts are in turmoil, and are never still; days of affliction come to meet me.
text_cn: 我内心烦恼不安，痛苦的日子常临于我。

text_en: I go about in sunless gloom; I stand up in the assembly and cry for help.
text_cn: 我忧闷而行，无人安慰我，我要在集会中起立喊冤。

text_en: I am a brother of jackals, and a companion of ostriches.
text_cn: 我成了豺狼的兄弟，成了鸵鸟的伴侣。

text_en: My skin turns black and falls from me, and my bones burn with heat.
text_cn: 我的皮肤变黑，我的骨头因热灼焦，

text_en: My lyre is turned to mourning, and my pipe to the voice of those who weep.
text_cn: 我的琴瑟奏出哀调，我的箫笛发出哭声。
